plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.197-198. A course may be used to satisfy only one requirement within the major, as printed.

courses.title: Professional and Career Exploration course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these Professional and Career Exploration courses, 2 credits as printed: CLD 1100 Exploring Career & Life Directions; CLD 3100 Experiencing Career & Life Directions; ECM 3800 Internship; ____ 3800 Internship (relevant to the major in another academic department).
